about: Dishes people eat at home, in restaurants and from take-out, including Canadian classics, under the names people order them. Each copies one USDA food (mostly FNDDS, which gives mixed dishes as eaten) or is a recipe of USDA foods with typical amounts; the basis names them. See README.md.

foods.name: Poutine
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709462: "Potato, french fries, restaurant" 200 g; USDA SR Legacy 173414: "Cheese, cheddar" 80 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2707145: "Gravy, beef" 120 g. Restaurant french fries with cheese curds and brown gravy. Cheese curds are fresh cheddar, so USDA cheddar stands in for them. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.

foods.name: Tourtière (meat pie)
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 167903: "Pork, fresh, ground, cooked" 95 g; USDA SR Legacy 167930: "Pie crust, refrigerated, regular, baked" 55 g; USDA SR Legacy 170440: "Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt" 25 g; USDA SR Legacy 170000: "Onions, raw" 12 g. Ground pork with potato and onion in a pastry crust. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.

foods.name: Montreal smoked meat sandwich
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 170200: "Beef, cured, corned beef, brisket, cooked" 150 g; USDA SR Legacy 172684: "Bread, rye" 64 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2710085: "Mustard" 10 g. Smoked brisket on two slices of rye with yellow mustard. USDA has no analysis of Montreal smoked meat; cooked corned beef brisket, the same cured beef brisket, stands in for it. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.

foods.name: Donair (Halifax style)
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2707616: "Bread, pita" 100 g; USDA SR Legacy 171800: "Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, loaf, cooked, baked" 140 g; USDA SR Legacy 171275: "Milk, canned, condensed, sweetened" 40 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709351: "Vinegar" 8 g; USDA SR Legacy 170000: "Onions, raw" 25 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709719: "Tomatoes, raw" 30 g. Spiced beef loaf, sliced, in a pita with sweet garlic sauce (condensed milk and vinegar), onion and tomato. USDA has no donair meat; baked ground beef loaf (80% lean) stands in for it. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.

foods.name: Nanaimo bar
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 173410: "Butter, salted" 190 g; USDA SR Legacy 169655: "Sugars, granulated" 50 g; USDA SR Legacy 169593: "Cocoa, dry powder, unsweetened" 30 g; USDA SR Legacy 171287: "Egg, whole, raw, fresh" 50 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2708133: "Graham crackers" 150 g; USDA SR Legacy 168586: "Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), sweetened, shredded" 60 g; USDA Foundation Foods 2346386: "Cream, heavy" 40 g; USDA SR Legacy 169698: "Cornstarch" 15 g; USDA SR Legacy 169656: "Sugars, powdered" 250 g; USDA SR Legacy 170271: "Chocolate, dark, 45- 59% cacao solids" 115 g. No-bake bar: graham crumb, coconut and cocoa base; custard butter icing (custard powder is mostly cornstarch); semisweet chocolate top. The amounts make one 8-inch pan of 16 bars. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.

foods.name: Butter tart
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 167930: "Pie crust, refrigerated, regular, baked" 300 g; USDA SR Legacy 168833: "Sugars, brown" 200 g; USDA SR Legacy 173410: "Butter, salted" 75 g; USDA SR Legacy 171287: "Egg, whole, raw, fresh" 100 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2710274: "Corn syrup" 80 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709212: "Raisins" 80 g. Pastry shells with a filling of brown sugar, butter, egg and corn syrup, with raisins. The amounts make 12 tarts. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients.
